id.description: Lowercase, dot-free id used for the plugin folder, vault namespace, and custom node namespace.

name.description: Display name shown on the integration card.

version.description: Plugin release version. Bump it for every published update.

description.description: Short description shown on the integration card and install consent dialog.

entry.description: Relative path to the plugin's self-contained ESM entry module.

fields.description: Configuration fields. Every community plugin must declare enabled as a boolean field.

configSchema.description: Settings form rendered by OSC Flow Studio.

type.description: Custom node type. Its plugin id segment must equal the manifest id.

nodeTypes.description: Custom trigger, action and input blocks contributed by the plugin.

templates.description: Ready-made flows users can import from the integration card.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this JSON Schema. OSC Flow Studio ignores this authoring-only property.
